Metadata.Goal: 在 foundation owner 提供 canonical RichDocument semantic translator 与 package-root runtime-first candidate materializer。
Metadata.Description: 把 revision-free RichDocument Interaction 的八类 semantic edits 原子应用为 candidate/copyOrigins，并与 existing trusted host、identity allocator 和 submission-time revision 链组合。

TaskSpace.name: add-rich-document-semantic-materializer
TaskSpace.Description: 按 public contract/red、materializer semantics、trusted-host integration/public exports/docs、strict verify 四个 TDD phase 实施。

TaskGroup.name: Public contract 与 red baseline
TaskGroup.Description: 先冻结 renderer-neutral canonical command/result、lossless normalizer handoff 与缺失 production values 的可复现红证据。

Task.name: 冻结 canonical semantic contract
Task.Description: 在 contract owner 设计 exact semantic node/edit/payload/command、copy provenance、materialization result/processor 与 validators；保留 Tiptap public type compatibility。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Contract typecheck 证明八种 edit 是封闭 renderer-neutral union，全部深只读且可序列化
Stable/local identity 互斥，copy provenance 只能引用 accepted stable #id，result type 只有 contract 一个 owner
Contract public surface 不出现 Tiptap/ProseMirror/Vue/DOM/HTML/xnl-core/VFS 类型

Task.name: 编写 translator/materializer package-root 红测试
Task.Description: 从 public roots 导入预期 canonical dialect/translator/materializer，建立当前 collection/export failure 和八类行为红测，禁止 deep import 或 test-local production substitute。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 红测准确因 public canonical translator/materializer values 缺失或行为未实现而失败
红测覆盖 malformed target/payload、stale before facts、atomic rejection 与 alias-safe immutable output

Task.name: 补齐 normalizer lossless characterization/red
Task.Description: 用真实 Editor transactions 锁定 text+mark final inline runs、new id claim stripping、单节点与嵌套 subtree copy source provenance、table descendant identity 和全部八种 edit。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 现状 characterizations 与新增红断言明确区分已有 edit coverage 和缺失 lossless/copy facts
测试不使用 editor.getJSON/HTML 作为 expected Domain candidate，也不伪造 allocator output

TaskGroup.name: Materializer semantics
TaskGroup.Description: 实现 canonical translator 与 accepted-baseline 两阶段 semantic candidate application，使 P1 红测按领域切片转绿。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: P1 contracts、characterizations 和预期红测试完成，失败原因只指向缺失 production behavior

Task.name: 实现 canonical translator 与 dialect
Task.Description: 复用 generic projection compiler/dialect protocol，验证 xnl.rich-document.edit、解析 plan target 并产生 fixed canonical Domain Command；同步 normalizer 输出到 canonical lossless payload。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Public dialect 与 runtime-first translator 对全部八种 edit 产生同一 canonical command shape
Unknown/unresolved/malformed/lossy input 返回 structured diagnostics，无 partial command 或 authority access
Tiptap semantic public types 成为 canonical alias/strict specialization，不保留第二 vocabulary owner

Task.name: 实现结构编辑与 identity/copy 规划
Task.Description: 以 accepted baseline 和 identity-keyed final placement plan 实现 insert/delete/move、local parent、nested subtree、replacement、temporary ids 与逐节点 copyOrigins。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Insert/delete/move 的混合顺序与 index permutation 得到确定 candidate，不逐条 splice accepted tree
Move 保留所有 stable #id；new/copy/replacement 临时 ids 无碰撞，copyOrigins 精确覆盖 copied persistent nodes
Unknown ref、invalid index、ancestor conflict、cyclic/self move、duplicate placement 与 forged identity 原子拒绝

Task.name: 实现 text mark code 与 Mermaid 语义
Task.Description: 基于 exact before/final inline runs coalesce text+mark，应用 code language/text 与 Mermaid source，并验证 stale/conflicting preconditions。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Text-only、mark-only 与同 transaction text+mark 保留 exact final run boundaries/link attrs
Code 与 Mermaid 更新保留 block #id 并 exact-match before facts
Content edit 与 deleted/replaced/table-owned descendant 冲突时 whole command rejected

Task.name: 实现 table 原子语义与 final normalization
Task.Description: 应用 table root before/after subtree，保留可对齐 identities/spans，处理 local/copy descendants，最后复用 parse/normalize/identity classifier 验证 candidate。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Table row/column/merge/split/header/content 结果保持 topology、colspan/rowspan、order 与 identity laws
实现不复制 ProseMirror table command 算法，也不读取 Tiptap JSON/HTML/DOM
Success result/copyOrigins 深冻结且 alias-safe；failure 不改变 accepted/command 或任何 authority

TaskGroup.name: Trusted host integration、public exports 与 docs
TaskGroup.Description: 把 production translator/materializer 接入 existing exact-once host，完成 package roots、兼容 aliases、边界 scans 和文档。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: P2 的八类 semantic unit/property tests 全绿，candidate identity classification 与 copyOrigins 可被 existing allocator chain 消费

Task.name: 编写并通过 trusted-host public-root integration
Task.Description: 先建立 production-values integration red，再连接 real normalizer、canonical translator/materializer、existing allocator、trusted host 与 accepted-first authoring session。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Translator/materializer 各 exactly once；stable revision 用 submission-time token，mid-flight revision change 不 submit
Allocator 只处理 new/copy/replacement 且收到准确 source provenance/reserved ids，move 不分配
Accepted PutGet、pre-accept failure 与 existing post-accept dirty-failed semantics 通过真实 public chain

Task.name: 收敛 package-root exports 与兼容 surface
Task.Description: 将 result contract 收敛到 contract owner，logic/support roots 暴露 production values，adapter root 保留 canonical aliases；更新 ESM/CJS/typecheck smoke 与 package boundary tests。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Consumer 仅经 package roots 可装配完整 chain，无 src deep import 或 test-local implementation
Contract/logic/support 无 Tiptap/Vue/DOM/HTML dependency，support 无第二 semantic algorithm
Public runtime/input/config/result 不泄漏 writer、VFS/VCS、session、revision、submit、persistence 或 adapter object

Task.name: 同步 Tiptap Document public docs
Task.Description: 更新 public API、projection/authoring、identity、usage tiers 与 current/future boundaries，给出 package-root composition 示例并移除 consumer-owned canonical translator/materializer 的过时说明。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 文档准确区分 canonical command、pre-authority candidate、allocator 与 accepted Domain truth
示例保持 revision-free Interaction 和 runtime-first capabilities，不出现 HTML/Tiptap JSON reverse authoring
当前/未来列表与 package-root tests 一致，不夸大 Workbench 产品集成状态

TaskGroup.name: Strict verify 与收口
TaskGroup.Description: 从 live repository 独立复现行为、类型、public roots、authority/identity laws 和 Codument 一致性，并以 fresh review loop 收敛。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: P3 public-root integration、package boundary scans 与文档全部完成

Task.name: 运行 package suites、typechecks 与 import smoke
Task.Description: 运行 contract/logic/support/Tiptap targeted 与 full suites、各 package typecheck、ESM/CJS public import smoke、dependency/residue scan 和 workspace regression。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 四 package targeted/full tests 与 typechecks 全绿，无 skipped canonical edit kind
ESM/CJS/public-root smoke 与 dependency scans 证明无 deep import、第二 vocabulary/materializer 或 forbidden dependency

Task.name: 运行 semantic laws 与 adversarial verification
Task.Description: 用 canonical fixtures、mixed edit permutations、copy subtree、table topology、stale/conflict/malformed/proxy/accessor inputs 和 concurrent revision probes 验证存在性、实质性、连通性。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: GetPut/PutGet、identity classification、copy allocator handoff 与 atomic rejection properties 全绿
Adversarial inputs 不执行 untrusted getters、不 mutate aliases、不泄漏 authority、不产生 partial candidate
Real normalizer -> translator -> materializer -> trusted host -> reproject chain 覆盖全部八种 edit

Task.name: 运行 strict Codument 与 fresh independent verify
Task.Description: 运行 codument validate add-rich-document-semantic-materializer --strict、codument modeling validate，并由 fresh codument-verify 逐项复现 behavior/proposal/design acceptance；修复后重跑直到无 issue。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Strict track validation 与 modeling validation 0 error
Fresh verifier 独立报告全部 acceptance 达成且无遗漏测试/authority/identity gap
Terminal AttractorCheck 与 verify-round GapLoop 收敛为 NO_GAP
